description_zh: 调用该接口分页查询所有规则列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-rule --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --current-page 1 --page-size 2 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRule

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 显示返回结果中的第几页。最大取值为1000，默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大值为100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

<notice>Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance level. The ResourceGroupId request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

RuleInfo.description_en:
The list of rule information returned if the call is successful. For more information, see RuleInfo.

The returned rules are sorted in reverse chronological order by creation time
RuleInfo.description_zh:
调用成功时，返回的规则信息列表。详情参见RuleInfo信息。

返回规则信息按照规则创建时间倒序排列

CreateUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the rule

Created.description_en: The CST (Central Standard Time) when the rule was created
Created.description_zh: 该规则创建时的CST（Central Standard Time）时间

DataType.description_en: The data type of the rule. Valid values: JSON and BINARY
DataType.description_zh: 该规则的数据类型，取值：JSON和BINARY

Modified.description_en: The CST (Central Standard Time) when the rule was last modified
Modified.description_zh: 该规则最近一次被修改时的CST （Central Standard Time）时间

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the rule applies

Select.description_en: The Select content in the SQL statement of the rule

ShortTopic.description_en:
The specific topic to which the rule applies (excluding the ProductKey category). Format: `${deviceName}/topicShortName`. ${deviceName} is the device name, and topicShortName is the remaining part of the topic.
If the topic contains the wildcard `+` or `#`, see [Topic wildcards]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html）
ShortTopic.description_zh:
应用该规则的具体Topic（不包含ProductKey类目），格式为：`${deviceName}/topicShortName`。其中，${deviceName}是具体设备的名称，topicShortName是Topic余下部分。
若Topic包含通配符`+`或`#`，请参见[Topic通配符说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html）

Status.description_en:
The running status of the rule. Valid values:

RUNNING: Running.
STOP: Stopped
Status.description_zh:
该规则的运行状态。取值：

RUNNING：运行中。
STOP：停止

Topic.description_en:
The specific topic to which the rule applies. Format: `${productKey}/${deviceName}/topicShortName`.
If the topic contains the wildcard `+` or `#`, see [Topic wildcards]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html）
Topic.description_zh:
应用该规则的具体Topic，格式为：`${productKey}/${deviceName}/topicShortName`。
若Topic包含通配符`+`或`#`，请参见[Topic通配符说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html）

UtcCreated.description_en: The UTC time when the rule was created

UtcModified.description_en: The UTC time when the rule was last modified
UtcModified.description_zh: 该规则最近一次被修改时的UTC时间

Where.description_en: The Where condition in the SQL statement of the rule
Where.description_zh: 该规则SQL语句中的Where查询条件

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
